paragraphs: TrueBlue, Inc. (the "company," "TrueBlue," "we," "us" and "our") began operations in 1989 and is a leading provider of specialized workforce solutions that connect employers and talent. Backed by decades of experience, an extensive national footprint, expansive talent network, deep local market insight, and global recruitment process outsourcing ("RPO") reach, TrueBlue delivers total workforce solutions helping clients improve quality, streamline operations and meet evolving talent demands.

In fiscal 2025, we connected approximately 291,000 people with work and served approximately 53,000 clients. Our operations are managed as three business segments: PeopleReady, PeopleManagement and PeopleSolutions.

PeopleReady connected approximately 130,000 people with work and served approximately 52,000 clients in fiscal 2025. PeopleReady provides clients with dependable access to qualified associates for their on-demand, contingent general and skilled labor needs to supplement their permanent workforce, across a broad range of industries including construction, transportation, manufacturing, retail, hospitality and energy. Our services range from providing one associate to hundreds, and are generally short-term in nature as we are filling the contingent staffing needs of our clients. Pricing reflects factors such as scope of engagement, role requirements and market conditions, offering flexibility based on workforce needs.

PeopleReady connects our clients with individuals looking for on-demand, general temporary and temp-to-hire positions through our vast network of physical branches across all 50 states in the United States ("U.S.") and Puerto Rico. Augmenting our branch network, our proprietary mobile app, JobStack®, connects people with on-demand work 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Supplemented by artificial intelligence ("AI"), JobStack creates a digital marketplace between our associates and clients, and allows our field resources to focus on sales, recruiting and service delivery efforts.

PeopleReady also connects skilled tradespeople with temporary work across a wide range of trades, including carpentry, electrical, plumbing, welding and energy installation positions through our PeopleReady Skilled Trades and RenewableWorks brands. We utilize our proprietary hiring and workforce management software, Stafftrack®, to recruit and connect skilled tradespeople with client assignments.
PeopleManagement connected approximately 38,000 people with work in fiscal 2025.

PeopleManagement provides and manages contingent associates at clients' facilities through our Staff Management | SMX ("Staff Management") and SIMOS Insourcing Solutions ("SIMOS") branded services throughout the U.S., Canada and Puerto Rico. Our client engagements are generally multi-location and multi-year, and include scalable recruiting, screening, hiring and management of the contingent workforce. We deploy dedicated management and service teams that work side-by-side with a client's full-time workforce. Our teams are an integral part of the production and logistics process, and specialize in labor-intensive manufacturing, warehousing and distribution. We offer hourly and productivity-based (cost-per-unit) pricing options for industrial staffing solutions. The productivity-based pricing leverages a strategically engineered on-site solution to incentivize performance improvements in cost, quality and on-time delivery using a fixed price-per-unit approach. Both hourly and productivity-based pricing are impacted by factors such as geography, volume, job type and degree of recruiting difficulty. Our proprietary hiring and workforce management software, Stafftrack, enables us to recruit and connect the best candidates with on-site assignments.

PeopleManagement also provides dedicated and contingent commercial drivers to the transportation and distribution industries through our Centerline Drivers ("Centerline") brand. Centerline matches drivers to each client's specific needs, allowing them to improve productivity, control costs, ensure compliance and deliver improved service. Pricing is impacted by factors such as geography, job type and solution. Centerline offers three solutions for clients:
•Flexible Drivers solution: On-demand service helping clients find drivers where and when they need them.
•Driver Management Services solution: Fully outsourced recruitment, management and supervision of drivers for a client.
•Mobile Drivers solution: Short-term relocation of qualified, experienced drivers for special projects or to high-need markets or remote locations where drivers are unavailable.

PeopleSolutions provides clients with services focusing on professional and specialized talent acquisition, as well as workforce management and compliance, and connected approximately 123,000 people with work in fiscal 2025, primarily in the U.S., Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia.

PeopleSolutions provides RPO, managed service provider ("MSP") solutions and talent advisory services through our PeopleScout brand. Our solutions are generally multi-year in duration, highly scalable and provide clients the support they need as their hiring volumes fluctuate. Pricing is typically composed of a fee for each hire and/or talent consulting fees, and is impacted by factors such as geography, volume, job type, degree of recruiting difficulty, and the scope of outsourced recruitment and employer branding services included. Our services are designed to lower client recruiting costs while improving the candidate experience by creating strategies that facilitate our clients' talent acquisition, development and retention goals. We tailor our services to individual client needs by offering multiple solutions, including the following:
•Full-cycle RPO solution: Provides oversight of the entire talent acquisition strategy, including sourcing, screening, hiring and onboarding of candidates.

paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves risk. The following risk factors and all other information set forth in this Annual Report on Form 10-K should be considered in evaluating our future prospects. If any of the events described below occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations, liquidity, or access to the capital markets could be materially and adversely affected.

To develop the following risk factors, we review risks to our business that are informed by our formal Enterprise Risk Management program, industry trends, the external market, and financial environment as well as dialogue with leaders throughout our organization. Our risk factors descriptions are intended to convey our assessment of each applicable risk and such assessments are prioritized and integrated into our strategic and operational planning.
RISKS RELATED TO OUR COMPANY'S OPERATIONS

The demand for our workforce solutions is highly dependent upon the state of the economy and the workforce needs of our clients, which creates uncertainty and volatility in our operations. Our profitability is sensitive to decreases in demand. National and global economic activity is slowed by many factors, including rising interest rates, recessionary periods, inflation, changes in international trade policies, declining consumer confidence, political and legislative policy changes, reductions in government funding, international conflict or instability, epidemics, other significant health concerns and global trade uncertainties. As economic activity slows, companies tend to reduce their use of associates and recruitment of new employees. We work in a broad range of industries that primarily include construction, manufacturing and logistics, warehousing and distribution, waste and recycling, energy, transportation, retail and hospitality. Significant declines in demand from any region or industry in which we have a major presence, domestic or global supply chain disruptions, or decline in the financial health of our clients, significantly decreases our revenues and profits. For example, we experienced significantly reduced demand from our clients due to the coronavirus pandemic ("COVID-19") and the resulting supply chain disruptions in the manufacturing and renewable energy sectors we serve. Global pandemics or other disruptions to the supply chain may impact our financial condition or results of operations and could have a material impact on the businesses or productivity of our clients, employees, associates and other partners.

A deterioration in real or perceived economic conditions, global supply chain issues, political instability, tariffs, rising energy prices, a recession or fear of a recession, and the related governmental responses to these concerns, or otherwise, could lead to a prolonged decline in demand for our services and negatively impact our business. During challenging economic times or in the event of a reduction or elimination of government funding, our clients, including but not limited to those that rely on government support, may face reduced demand for their services, reduced revenue, and issues gaining access to sufficient credit, which has resulted in and could in the future result in a reduction in the need for our services, or an impairment of their ability to make payments to us, timely or otherwise, for services rendered. If that were to occur, it may adversely affect our results of operations.

It is difficult for us to forecast future demand for our services due to the inherent uncertainty in forecasting the direction and strength of economic cycles and the project-based nature of our staffing assignments. The uncertainty can be exacerbated by volatile economic conditions, which have caused and may continue to cause clients to reduce or defer projects for which they utilize our services. The negative impact to our business can occur before, during or after a decline in economic activity is seen in the broader economy. When it is difficult for us to accurately forecast future demand, we may not be able to determine the optimal level of personnel and investment necessary to profitably manage our business in light of opportunities and risks we face.

paragraphs: Total company revenue grew 3.1% to $1.6 billion for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025, compared to the prior year. Growth was primarily due to the acquisition of Healthcare Staffing Professionals, Inc. in early 2025, as well as strong demand within our skilled businesses, while conditions continue to stabilize within on-demand, on-site and permanent hiring.

Total company gross profit as a percentage of revenue for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025 contracted 310 basis points to 22.8%, compared to the prior year. The decline was primarily due to changes in revenue mix toward our lower margin staffing businesses, as well as less favorability in prior year workers' compensation reserve adjustments.

Total company selling, general and administrative ("SG&A") expense decreased 9.7% to $371.1 million for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025, compared to the prior year. SG&A expense decreased as a result of continued operational cost management actions in response to the decline in demand for our services, and the simplification of our organizational structure in line with our strategic plan.

We recorded a goodwill and intangible asset impairment charge of $0.2 million during the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025, related to a trademark within our PeopleManagement segment. For the same period in the prior year, we recorded goodwill and intangible asset impairment charges of $59.7 million, primarily related to our PeopleReady reporting unit.

We recorded a right-of-use and other long-lived asset impairment charge of $18.4 million during the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025, related to the execution of a sublease for our Chicago support center as part of our continued efforts to shift to a remote or hybrid work model for our headquarters and United States ("U.S.") based support teams.

Income tax expense was $2.3 million for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025, compared to $37.2 million for the same period in the prior year. We continue to maintain a valuation allowance against our U.S. federal, state and certain foreign deferred tax assets initially established in the fiscal second quarter of 2024, resulting in no current period income tax benefit for these jurisdictions.
The items described above contributed to our net loss of $48.0 million for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025, compared to net loss of $125.7 million in the prior year.

As of December 28, 2025, we had cash and cash equivalents of $24.5 million and outstanding debt of $65.8 million. As of December 28, 2025, $67.6 million was available under the most restrictive covenant of our revolving credit agreement ("Revolving Credit Facility"), for total liquidity of $92.1 million.

paragraphs: TrueBlue, Inc. (the "company," "TrueBlue," "we," "us" and "our") 在 1989 年開始營運，並為專門的人力資源解決方案供應商，連結僱主與人才。憑藉數十年的經驗、廣泛的全國網路、龐大的人才網路、深入的當地市場洞察力，以及全球招聘流程委外 ("RPO") 能力，TrueBlue 提供完整的 workforce 解決方案，協助客戶提升品質、簡化作業並應對不斷變化的人才需求。
在財務年度 2025 年，我們連結約 291,000 人與工作，並服務約 53,000 家客戶。我們的營運分為三個業務應報告分部：PeopleReady、PeopleManagement 和 PeopleSolutions。

PeopleReady 在財務年度 2025 年連結約 130,000 人與工作，並服務約 52,000 家客戶。PeopleReady 提供客戶可靠且具資格的員工，以應對其即時、臨時的一般及專業技能人力需求，用以補足其永久員工，橫跨廣泛的產業，包括建築、運輸、製造、零售、旅館及能源。我們的服務範圍從提供單一員工到數百名員工，且通常為短期性質，因我們是為客戶的臨時人力需求進行填補。價格反映因素如合作範圍、職務需求及市場條件，並根據人力需求提供靈活性。
PeopleReady 透過我們遍佈美國 ("U.S.") 全 50 州及波多黎各的實體門市網路，連結客戶與尋求即時、一般臨時及臨時轉正職位的個人。輔以我們專屬的行動應用程式 JobStack®，可 24 小時、7 天 7 夜提供即時工作機會。透過人工智慧 ("AI")，JobStack® 創造一個數位市場，連結我們的員工與客戶，並讓我們的現場資源專注於銷售、招募及服務交付。
PeopleReady 也透過 PeopleReady Skilled Trades 和 RenewableWorks 品牌，連結具專業技能的技工與臨時工作，涵蓋廣泛的技工種類，包括木工、電氣、水管、焊接及能源安裝等職位。我們利用專屬的招募及人力管理軟體 Stafftrack®，來招募並連結具專業技能的技工與客戶工作指派。
PeopleManagement 在財務年度 2025 年連結約 38,000 人與工作。

PeopleManagement 提供並管理客戶場地的臨時員工，透過我們的 Staff Management | SMX ("Staff Management") 和 SIMOS Insourcing Solutions ("SIMOS") 品牌服務，服務範圍遍及美國、加拿大及波多黎各。我們的客戶合作通常為多據點、多年度，包含可擴充的招募、篩選、聘用及管理臨時員工。我們部署專屬的管理及服務團隊，與客戶的全職員工共同作業。我們的團隊是生產及物流流程的重要組成部分，專精於勞動密集型製造、倉儲及物流。我們提供每小時及以產出為基礎 (每單位成本) 的計價選項，用於工業人力解決方案。以產出為基礎的計價方式，利用策略性工程的現場解決方案，以激勵成本、品質及準時交付的表現改進，採用固定每單位價格方式。每小時及以產出為基礎的計價均受地理因素、交易量、工作類型及招募困難程度等因素影響。我們的專屬招募及人力管理軟體 Stafftrack，使我們能招募並連結最佳人選與現場工作指派。
PeopleManagement 也透過 Centerline Drivers ("Centerline") 品牌，為運輸及物流產業提供專屬及臨時的商業駕駛。Centerline 根據客戶的特定需求匹配駕駛，使客戶能提升生產力、控制成本、確保合規並提供更優質的服務。計價受地理因素、工作類型及解決方案等因素影響。Centerline 為客戶提供三種解決方案：
•Flexible Drivers 解決方案：提供按需服務，協助客戶在需要時及地點找到司機。
•Driver Management Services 解決方案：為客戶提供完整的委外招募、管理及監督司機服務。
•Mobile Drivers 解決方案：為特殊專案或高需求市場或遠端地區（司機不足之處）短期調派具資格且經驗豐富的司機。
PeopleSolutions 提供專注於專業及專門人才招募、人力管理與合規服務，並在財務年度 2025 年連接約 123,000 人從事工作，主要位於美國、加拿大、英國及澳洲。

PeopleSolutions 透過我們的 PeopleScout 品牌提供 RPO、受託管理服務供應商（"MSP"）解決方案及人才諮詢服務。我們的解決方案通常為多年期，高度可擴展，並為客戶在招聘量波動時提供所需支援。價格通常由每筆招聘費用及/或人才諮詢費用組成，並受地理因素、招募量、工作類型、招募困難程度及包含的委外招募與僱主品牌服務範圍等因素影響。我們的服務旨在降低客戶招聘成本，同時透過創造策略改善候選人體驗，協助客戶達成人才招募、培訓與留任目標。我們根據客戶個別需求提供多種解決方案，包括以下內容：
•Full-cycle RPO 解決方案：提供整體人才招募策略的監督，包括候選人來源、篩選、招聘及入職流程。

paragraphs: 本公司營業收入成長 3.1% 至 1.6 十億美元，為財務年度終了於 2025 年 12 月 28 日，相較於前一財年。成長主要係因於 2025 年初收購 Healthcare Staffing Professionals, Inc.，以及我們專業技能業務之強勁需求，同時在即時需求、現場服務及永久僱用領域之情況持續穩定。
本公司營業毛利佔營業收入之百分比，為財務年度終了於 2025 年 12 月 28 日，較前一財年下降 310 基點至 22.8%。此下降主要係因營收組成轉向我們毛利率較低之人力派遣業務，以及前一財年員工補償備抵調整之不具利潤性。
本公司銷售、一般及行政（"SG&A"）費用減少 9.7% 至 371.1 百萬美元，為財務年度終了於 2025 年 12 月 28 日，相較於前一財年。SG&A 費用減少係因應我們服務需求下降，持續進行運營成本管理措施，以及根據我們戰略計畫簡化組織架構所致。
我們於財務年度終了於 2025 年 12 月 28 日，因應 PeopleManagement 分部之商標，記錄 goodwill 及無形資產減損費用 0.2 百萬美元。於相同期間之前一財年，我們記錄 goodwill 及無形資產減損費用 59.7 百萬美元，主要係因 PeopleReady 報告分部所致。
所得稅費用為 2.3 百萬美元，於財務年度終了於 2025 年 12 月 28 日，較前一財年相同期間的 37.2 百萬美元。我們持續維持對美國聯邦、州及某些外國遞延所得稅資產的評價允許減損，此項評價允許減損於 2024 財年第二季 initially 建立，導致這些管轄地區在當期無所得稅利益。
上述所述項目導致我們於財務年度終了於 2025 年 12 月 28 日的淨虧損為 48.0 百萬美元，較前一財年的淨虧損 125.7 百萬美元為少。
截至2025年12月28日，我們持有現金及現金等價物24.5 百萬美元，並有65.8 百萬美元未償還債務。截至2025年12月28日，根據我們循環信貸協議（"Revolving Credit Facility"）中最嚴格的契約條款，我們可使用的資金為67.6 百萬美元，總流動性為92.1 百萬美元。

headings: 我們的勞動力解決方案需求會受到總體經濟狀況波動的重大影響。
失去、持續減少或某些產業收入大幅下降，可能對我們的營業收入、獲利能力及流動性產生重大不利影響。
新業務策略可能導致我們增加支出，並對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們的品牌與聲譽受損可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們可能無法實現業務策略的預期效果，這可能對我們的營運結果產生負面影響。
併購可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
由於過去的併購，我們在資產負債表中保留了商譽與無形資產，若我們認列減損，可能會降低我們的獲利或增加我們的虧損。
委外處理我們業務的部分內容，可能導致營運中斷與成本增加。
本公司無法保證將依照本公司股票回購計畫回購普通股，亦無法保證該股票回購計畫將提升長期股東價值。
本公司負債水準及信用協議中的限制條款，可能對本公司營運造成負面影響，並限制本公司流動性及對經濟變動反應的能力。
本公司可能無法將成本結構與目前營業收入水準對齊，進而可能需要未來進行額外融資，而該融資可能無法取得或僅能以不利條件取得。
本公司可能面臨額外稅務負擔，該負擔可能高於本公司預估金額。
未能維持適當的財務及管理程序與控制機制，可能導致財務報導錯誤或無法防止或偵測詐欺行為。
本公司可能遭遇與僱用相關的索賠、商業賠償索賠及其他法律程序，該等索賠可能對本公司業務造成重大損害。
未能保護本公司智慧財產權可能損害本公司業務，且本公司面臨服務或產品可能侵權他人智慧財產權或契約權利的風險。
本公司努力維持適當的合規政策與控制機制，可能無法防止違規行為，該違規行為可能導致重大罰款與處罰。
本公司之人力資源解決方案受廣泛政府規範及可能增加之規範影響，可能對本公司未來獲利造成重大損害。
本公司可能無法吸引足夠具備資格之員工及候選人以滿足客戶之需求。
本公司所處產業為高度競爭，可能無法維持客戶、市場佔有率或利潤率。
本公司業務受不斷演進之規範及利害關係人期待影響，可能使本公司面臨眾多風險。
來自再生能源客戶對本公司服務之需求或相關政府資金之挹注，可能隨時間減少。
網路安全漏洞及其他事件可能導致客戶、候選人、員工及員工之資訊遭不當揭露，可能對本公司業務造成重大損害。
資料安全、資料隱私權及資料保護法規及其他科技法規，可能增加本公司之成本。
本公司資訊科技系統之失敗可能對營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司廠房及營運可能因損壞或中斷而受影響。
本公司開發及應用人工智能技術涉及風險與不確定性，可能使本公司面臨法律、聲譽及財務上的損失。
若本公司未能吸引、培養及留住合資格員工，本公司營運結果可能大幅惡化。
本公司高階主管或其他關鍵人員離職，或管理團隊發生重大變動，可能幹擾本公司營運或損害本公司業務。
paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及風險。下列風險因素及本年度報告表 10-K 中所載的所有其他資訊，應作為評估本公司未來前景之參考。若下列所描述之任何事件發生，將可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運結果、流動性或取得資本市場之能力造成重大且不利之影響。
為發展下列風險因素，我們會審視對本公司業務之風險，這些風險來自我們正式之企業風險管理計畫、產業趨勢、外部市場與財務環境，以及與組織內領導者之對話。我們之風險因素描述旨在傳達我們對每項適用風險之評估，且這些評估會被優先考量並整合至我們之戰略與營運規劃中。
與本公司營運相關之風險

我們之人力解決方案需求高度依賴經濟狀況與客戶之人力需求，這會造成我們營運之不確定性與波動性。我們之獲利能力對需求下降非常敏感。國家與全球經濟活動受多種因素影響而減緩，包括利率上升、經濟衰退期、通貨膨脹、國際貿易政策變動、消費者信心下降、政治與立法政策變動、政府經費減少、國際衝突或不穩定、疫情、其他重大健康問題及全球貿易不確定性。當經濟活動減緩時，企業傾向減少使用員工與招募新進員工。我們服務的產業範圍廣泛，主要包括建設、製造與物流、倉儲與配送、廢棄物與回收、能源、運輸、零售與餐飲。若任何地區或產業之需求大幅下降，或國內外供應鏈中斷，或客戶之財務狀況惡化，將顯著降低我們之營收與獲利。例如，我們因冠狀病毒疫情（"COVID-19"）及製造業與可再生能源產業所導致之供應鏈中斷，而經歷了客戶需求顯著下降。全球性疫情或其他供應鏈中斷可能影響我們之財務狀況或營運結果，並可能對客戶、員工、合作夥伴及其他合作方之業務或生產力造成重大影響。

實質或被認為經濟狀況惡化、全球供應鏈問題、政治不穩定、關稅、能源價格上升、經濟衰退或對經濟衰退之擔憂，以及政府對這些問題之相關應對措施，或其他因素，可能導致我們服務之需求延長下降，並對我們之業務造成負面影響。在經濟困難時期或政府經費減少或取消時，包括但不僅限於依賴政府支持之客戶，可能面臨其服務之需求減少、營收減少，以及取得足夠信貸之困難，這已導致並可能在未來導致對我們服務之需求減少，或其無法按時或按期支付我們所提供之服務費用。若發生此情況，將可能對我們之營運結果造成不利影響。

由於預測未來服務需求之困難，我們難以預測未來之需求。這是因為預測經濟週期之方向與強度存在內在不確定性，且我們之人力派遣業務具有項目導向性。不確定性可能因經濟條件波動而加劇，這已導致並可能持續導致客戶減少或延後使用我們服務之項目。對我們業務之負面影響可能在經濟活動於整體經濟中顯現之前、期間或之後發生。當我們難以準確預測未來需求時，我們可能無法確定適切之人力與投資水平，以在面對機會與風險時，有利地管理我們之業務。
